OWNER_EMAIL.description: Recommended. Your email address. Only this email can create the owner account the first time you open /admin, so nobody else who finds the URL can claim your blog.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional. The sender for newsletters and sign-in emails, for example `My Blog <hello@yourdomain.com>`. Needs a domain onboarded to Cloudflare Email Service. Leave empty and Writestead shows confirmation links instead of emailing them.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional. A Cloudflare Turnstile secret key. Set it together with the TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY variable to protect subscribe, comment and sign-up forms from bots.
